G5415.name: Fortunatus
G5415.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5415.brief: Corinthian Christian; visited Paul in Ephesus.
G5415.short: Fortunatus was a Corinthian Christian who, along with Stephanas and Achaicus, visited Paul in Ephesus and refreshed his spirit.

G5402.name: Phoebe
G5402.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G5402.brief: Deacon of the church in Cenchreae
G5402.short: Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae, whom Paul commended to the believers in Rome.

G5436.name: Phygelus
G5436.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5436.brief: Believer who deserted Paul in Asia
G5436.short: Phygelus, along with Hermogenes, was mentioned by Paul as having deserted him during his ministry in Asia.

G5403.name: Phoenicia
G5403.brief: A region and people on the Mediterranean coast
G5403.short: Phoenicia was a region along the Mediterranean coast, north of Israel, known for its maritime trade and mentioned in the New Testament in connection with the spread of the gospel.

G5405.name: Phoenix
G5405.brief: A harbor on the island of Crete
G5405.short: Phoenix was a harbor on the island of Crete where the ship carrying Paul and other prisoners attempted to winter during their journey to Rome.

G5435.name: Phrygia
G5435.brief: A region in Asia Minor with early Christians
G5435.short: Phrygia was a region in Asia Minor where Paul traveled and preached the gospel, and some of its inhabitants were present in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
